name: pergram
description: サプリメントを有効成分1単位あたりの価格で比較する静的サイト

scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.d1:schema: npx wrangler d1 execute pergram --remote --file worker/schema.sql
scripts.d1:schema:local: npx wrangler d1 execute pergram --local --file worker/schema.sql
scripts.d1:waitlist: npx wrangler d1 execute pergram --remote --command "SELECT * FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
